name: schemaemitter-kindof-type-fallback
body: KindOf classifies a declaring statement into the resolver's Kind by the same statement classes Declare accepts, checking table types before alias/CLR types, and maps any statement it does not recognise to Type; this holds because Declare admits only the nine declaring statement kinds. Upgrade KindOf alongside Declare whenever a new declaring statement kind is admitted, so it never silently becomes a Type.
